## Understanding AS2
AS2 uses public key cryptography to sign and encrypt messages over HTTP/S.  
<img border="1" src="data:image/gif;base64," />  

AS2 MDN (message disposition notification) is optional acknowledgment message that can be sent a/synchronously.  
<img border="1" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," />  
<img border="1" src="data:image/jpeg;base64," />

## Debugging AS2
**RSSBus Connect** is a very useful tool to send and receive AS2 messages for free. Download it from https://www.rssbus.com/. Use **RSSBus Connect** to test new/existing BizTalk receive ports. For BizTalk send ports, simply turn on trackings to see AS2 headers.  

> The following screenshots are took from **RSSBus Connect 2019**.  

Under **PROFILE**, you can **Create Certificate**.  
<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  

At the bottom of the page, click on your **Public URL** and **Download** your public certificate to import it into BizTalk.  
<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  
<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  

Under **FLOWS**, add a new AS2 connector and set up accordingly.  
<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />  

You can then send files from **Input**, and see inbound files in **Output**.  
<img border="1" src="data:image/png;base64," />
